title: Castelion roles
description: A navy band listing open roles: a big bold title and one line of copy on the left, and on the right a fixed-height scroll box of tall cards outlined in 2px cream with 4px corners (role in bold, place in bold below), cut off at the band's foot. Beside the box runs a thin cream rail with a small dart that travels down it as the list scrolls. Cards tint on hover.
notes: the band is bg-secondary in a dark scope; it has no bottom padding (the list runs to its foot), like the original
the list scrolls natively (wheel, touch, keyboard); the rail's dart follows it with a CSS scroll timeline and stays at the top without support
